fields.fld6QfqVNiOfu4E8v: Mainland route Corinth–Athens, Scironian passage (exact site unverified); perpetrators described as 'of Thermia/Kythnos'
fields.fldHJS3jVXmTyPKPq: CORRECTED geographic interpretation: not on Kythnos, but along mainland Corinth–Athens route. Exact capture location requires historical Scironian road evidence. Both letters are from same Spon chain. Reported informants not yet independently inspected; manuscript facsimiles not checked. No coordinates.
fields.fldVWYatolwq17NHa: François Chastaignier (French consul in Athens); unidentified 'corsaires de Thermia'; Jacob Spon
fields.fldWVuhJJH5AvyTAx: François Chastaignier killed by 'corsaires de Thermia' on Corinth–Athens passage (c. Oct 1679)
fields.fldtMLLeVODTrDXDC: Spon's letter of 12 Jan 1680 explicitly places Chastaignier's capture on his journey from Corinth to Athens at the Scironian passage. His 24 Feb letter confirms report and names three informants. The 12 Jan letter's modern editor dates death early October 1679. These are two letters by same author, not two independent chains. This is NOT an attack ON Kythnos.
fields.fldu9LmyWh9wQOOvT: Early October 1679 (editorial dating); reported 12 Jan and 24 Feb 1680
